dfc-b:name: 2023 harvest
dfc-b:description:
Organic extra virgin olive oil. Our popular Priola and Frantoio olives were all picked on one day, and went through the press together to make this delicious oil.

Packed in an easy to handle bag in box, with a press tap for easy dispensing. The bag in box excludes light and reduces oxidation as the oil is used, preserving the oil quality.
